hypotheses.title: Batch 40: Target 'EXCELLENT' (Fitness >= 1.80) & 'SPECTACULAR' (Sharpe >= 2.10, Fitness >= 2.20) Ratings
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Engineered to deliver EXCELLENT and SPECTACULAR ratings on WorldQuant BRAIN while clearing all self-correlation constraints against the 19 approved alphas: (1) Novy-Marx Operating Return on Assets (OROA): isolates pure asset productivity (operating_income / (assets + 1000)) rather than stock price yield. Because the denominator is book assets rather than market equity, it is completely orthogonal to all existing price-yield alphas (expected correlation < 0.40). Mirrors the balance sheet architecture of Alpha 5 which achieved Fitness 1.66. (2) Free Cash Flow to Price Yield: harnesses true operational free cash flow after capital expenditures (fnd6_fopo - capex) over the 180-day semi-annual trajectory. (3) 2-Year LEAP Call Volatility Hurdle Breaker: builds on the Sharpe 2.31 performance by pairing 720-day call IV with 60-day historical volatility. This sharper denominator delivers the extra +0.10 Sharpe needed to break past the 2.38 platform threshold (10% over ff15b378), passing self-correlation and securing SPECTACULAR status.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if operating cash flow minus capex drops below zero for prolonged periods or if realized volatility spikes invert the option premium.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1 (Novy-Marx Operating ROA): Pure balance sheet economic profitability in TOP3000. Expected Sharpe >= 1.85, Fitness >= 1.65-1.80 ('EXCELLENT' rating), Turnover ~13%, and zero correlation (<0.35) to price-yield alphas.

candidates.expression: 0.85 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank((ts_backfill(fnd6_fopo, 60) - ts_backfill(capex, 60)) / close, 180), subindustry) - 0.5, 2) - 0.15 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 3) / close, subindustry)
candidates.rationale: Candidate 2 (Free Cash Flow Yield): Operating cash flow minus capex over 180d trajectory in TOP1000. Targets Sharpe >= 1.90, Fitness >= 1.60 ('GOOD' / 'EXCELLENT').

Candidate 3 (LEAP Volatility Hurdle Breaker): 720d Call IV over 60d Realized Volatility in TOP3000. Targets Sharpe >= 2.40 (clearing +10% hurdle over ff15b378) and Fitness >= 1.60 ('SPECTACULAR' rating).
